text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Days of working hard toward the Unicorn 
Stakes. Shinko Windy gets bored from doing 
the exact same training routine every 
single day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, good news arrived. An offer 
came in to participate in a nationwide 
live-broadcast exhibition race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Show the racing world a strength that will 
echo a hundred years into the future. The 
chance to fulfill that "ambition" has 
arrived immediately! Shinko Windy happily 
and eagerly agrees to participate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy devoted herself to training 
once again, setting new personal records 
day after day. Once she focused, she was 
truly formidable.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer had no doubt she would surely 
win, and that it would be a major step 
toward their "ambition." ...At this time, 
at least.
